title: Split Logs for the Blacksmith
summary: Sander Stooks wants 4 split logs from the great oak taken to Cordell Lathom before the rain turns the lane to soup, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need split logs, and what is stacked at the great oak is the town's to take. Carry it to Cordell Lathom before the rain turns the lane to soup, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Ashford that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 4 split logs from the pile
Hand the split logs to Cordell Lathom
Tell Sander Stooks it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
